title: Don’t Look Now, But Anthropic is Bypassing Hyperscalers
excerpt: The company signed two back-to-back deals with obtain compute power from companies that are not hyperscalers. The audacity.
content_html:
THE GIST

Our analysts just identified a stock with the potential to be the next Nvidia. Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick. Tap here.

Anthropic needs electricity, and it has stopped being fussy about where the plug comes from. The frontier labs were supposed to get their compute from hyperscalers, which is how OpenAI and Microsoft still do it. Anthropic has instead spent the past week handing enormous, decades-long contracts to a Bitcoin miner in Texas and a Norwegian startup that did not exist in January.

WHAT HAPPENED

Anthropic locked in roughly $19 billion of new compute contracts inside a single week, split between a 20-year agreement with Riot Platforms worth $9 billion and a $10 billion arrangement with infrastructure startup Volta Infra Holdings.

Riot, a Texan Bitcoin mining company, disclosed a 20-year deal to supply 191 megawatts of capacity from its Rockdale, Texas campus, enough to power roughly 143,000 homes at any given moment.

Riot expects the contract to generate $9 billion in revenue, with 2 extension options of 5 years each that could push total value to $16 billion. Investors were delighted and pushed the stock up 25% in after-hours trading.

The Volta deal signed last week is structurally different. The 6-month-old startup will deliver compute from a hydro-powered data center in Norway, capacity pegged at 133 megawatts, with handoff occurring in 2 phases through March 2027.

WHY IT MATTERS

Both deals reveal Anthropic's strategy of bypassing hyperscalers to find compute wherever it exists. Riot Platforms began life as a diagnostics company before becoming a Bitcoin miner and then an AI host. Volta did not exist at the start of the year and today holds a $10 billion deal with a frontier AI lab.

One stock. Nvidia-level potential. 30M+ investors trust Moby to find it first. Get the pick. Tap here.

These are not no-name newbies, though. Volta was founded in January by former Brookfield Asset Management executives and had raised just $300 million across seed and Series A rounds, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Altimeter, and Nvidia, before landing a $2.4 billion valuation.

Nvidia is both an investor in Volta and its chip supplier, which highlights the circulatory movement of capital in AI, where chipmakers, cloud startups, and labs increasingly fund each other's growth. Everyone should be asking where that money enters and exits, though that is a different story.

Riot has an eclectic past. It was founded as Bioptix, a biotech diagnostics company, before its dramatic turn to Bitcoin mining. It runs a large-scale operation out of Rockdale and has now layered AI data center hosting on top of the mining business. Q2 revenue came to $174 million, a 14% jump from the previous year, with Bitcoin mining contributing $113.7 million and data centers $23.2 million. Before anyone gets excited, the company is still in the red, with losses above $200 million.

content_html_zh:
要点

我们的分析师刚刚发现了一只有潜力成为下一个英伟达的股票。 告诉我们您如何投资，我们将向您展示为什么它是我们的第一选择。 点击此处。

Anthropic需要电力，而且它不再对插头的来源挑剔。 前沿实验室应该从超大规模厂商那里获得计算，OpenAI 和微软仍然这样做。 相反，Anthropic 在过去的一周里将长达数十年的巨额合同交给了德克萨斯州的一家比特币矿商和一家一月份还不存在的挪威初创公司。

发生了什么

Anthropic 在一周内锁定了约 190 亿美元的新计算合同，其中包括与 Riot Platforms 签订的价值 90 亿美元的 20 年协议，以及与基础设施初创公司 Volta Infra Holdings 签订的 100 亿美元的协议。

德克萨斯州比特币挖矿公司 Riot 披露了一项为期 20 年的协议，将从其德克萨斯州罗克代尔园区提供 191 兆瓦的电力，足以在任何特定时刻为大约 143,000 个家庭供电。

Riot 预计该合同将产生 90 亿美元的收入，并有 2 个为期 5 年的延期选项，可以将总价值推至 160 亿美元。 投资者很高兴，并推动该股在盘后交易中上涨 25%。

上周签署的 Volta 协议在结构上有所不同。 这家成立 6 个月的初创公司将从挪威的一个水力发电数据中心提供计算，容量为 133 兆瓦，到 2027 年 3 月将分两个阶段进行移交。

为什么它很重要

这两笔交易都揭示了 Anthropic 的战略，即绕过超大规模企业，在任何存在的地方寻找计算。 Riot Platforms 最初是一家诊断公司，后来成为比特币矿工和人工智能主机。 Volta 在今年年初还不存在，如今与一家前沿人工智能实验室签订了价值 100 亿美元的协议。

一只股票。 Nvidia 级别的潜力。 超过 3000 万投资者相信 Moby 能够首先找到它。 得到选秀权。 点击此处。

不过，这些人并不是无名新手。 Volta 由布鲁克菲尔德资产管理公司 (Brookfield Asset Management) 前高管于 1 月创立，在安德森霍洛维茨 (Andreessen Horowitz)、Altimeter 和 Nvidia 的支持下，在种子轮和 A 轮融资中仅筹集了 3 亿美元，随后估值达到 24 亿美元。

英伟达既是 Volta 的投资者，又是其芯片供应商，这凸显了人工智能领域资本的循环流动，芯片制造商、云初创公司和实验室越来越多地相互资助对方的发展。 每个人都应该问这些钱进出哪里，尽管这是一个不同的故事。

Riot有着不拘一格的过去。 它的前身是 Bioptix，一家生物技术诊断公司，后来急剧转向比特币挖矿。 该公司在罗克代尔开展大规模业务，目前已在采矿业务之上分层托管人工智能数据中心。 第二季度收入达到 1.74 亿美元，比上年增长 14%，其中比特币挖矿贡献 1.137 亿美元，数据中心贡献 2320 万美元。 在大家兴奋之前，该公司仍然处于亏损状态，损失超过 2 亿美元。
